summary: Textron Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its intent to separate its Industrial segment (Kautex and Textron Specialized Vehicles) from its core aerospace and defense businesses. The separation may be structured as a sale or a tax-free spin-off into a standalone public company. No financial terms, premium, or advisor were disclosed. The company targets completion within 12–18 months, subject to regulatory approvals and board final approval. Watch for structural election (sale vs. spin) and any tax implications; risk-arb will focus on execution timeline and potential buyer interest if a sale path is chosen.
